posts.topic: A detector says Maya's handwritten post is "likely AI", and she's sure Google will bin it
posts.reason: Frames 07–08 (claim is untrue): The payoff says 'Google never asked how I wrote it', and the 'Google's questions' card, credited to Search Central, is built to show that 'none of Google's questions asks how the post was written'. That is false. Google's Search Central guidance on helpful content tells creators to ask 'Who, How, and Why' about their content.
